diagram_previews.alt: An equilateral triangle ABC with three congruent blue circles with centres O1, O2, O3, each tangent to two sides and to the other two circles; the red radius r from O1 to AB, the red dashed segment O1O2 = 2r, and the lengths r sqrt 3 from A and from B to the nearest points of tangency.
